title: AlphaDent: A dataset for automated tooth pathology detection
class_taxonomy: 9 classes (instance segmentation); caries split into 6 sub-classes (5 standard + WHO immune-zone localization)
notes: 295 patients, DSLR Canon 6D Mark II + 100mm macro + intraoral mirror. Data collected Jan 2024 - Jan 2025 at First Moscow State Medical University (Sechenov, ethics protocol No. 02-24). Team: Sosnin, Vasilev et al (ZFTurbo/AlphaDent). Mirrors: github.com/ZFTurbo/AlphaDent, kaggle.com/competitions/alpha-dent, HuggingFace, Zenodo. Pretrained weights + leaderboard. FIRST fully open Russian intraoral instance-segmentation dataset.

title: AlphaDent: Teeth marking (Kaggle Competition)
class_taxonomy: Same 9 classes as AlphaDent arXiv paper (caries, plaque, gingiva, ortho elements, etc.)
notes: Kaggle mirror of AlphaDent. Train/val split by patient: 273 train / 22 val. Hidden test set for leaderboard. Task = instance segmentation of 9 oral pathology classes on intraoral DSLR photos.

title: AlphaDent GitHub repository (code + weights + dataset links)
class_taxonomy: Two configurations available: 9-class full taxonomy and a compacted 4-class variant
notes: Official code repo by ZFTurbo. yolo_seg_train.yaml, pretrained YOLOv8 weights, train/val/inference scripts. Dataset mirrored on Zenodo, Kaggle, HuggingFace per README. Same dataset as alphadent-arxiv-2507-22512.

title: YuFU/SFedU smartphone caries detection prototype dataset
source_platform: SFEDU press release / Nauka i Zhizn / Ferra.ru
notes: Denis Krivoguz team at Southern Federal University (Rostov-on-Don). Built YOLOv8 caries detector on smartphone camera intraoral photos. Internal research sample: 1781 patients, 5000+ affected teeth. Training used the public Pakistani (Mithi, Sindh) dataset; the SFedU own sample is NOT publicly released as of April 2026. Lead for next iteration via hub.sfedu.ru repository.

title: Sechenov University first Minzdrav AI-platform dataset: Sjogren syndrome salivary gland pathology
class_taxonomy: 6 classes of changes in minor salivary glands (Sjogren / sialadenitis)
notes: OUT-OF-SCOPE (histology, not intraoral photo) but logged as negative anchor + institutional lead. Institute of Clinical Morphology & Digital Pathology, Sechenov. Three more datasets being prepared by the same team - revisit in future iterations for possible intraoral soft-tissue modalities.
